summary: No mathematical errors or gaps found. The boundary-inclusive entropy identity and complete-support capacity baseline are applied with their hypotheses and normalizations intact. The directional fourth-moment expansion, halfspace mass bound, likelihood change of measure, capacity-weighted averaging, and restoration of uncertified small blocks establish the stated second-moment estimates. Jensen gives exactly the third-moment estimates, and capacity factorization gives all stated capacity moments. Singleton and zero-dimensional supports, zero variances, b = 0, and uniformity over arbitrary finite selections are covered.
